descriptions.preferred: Acer circinatum 'Baby Buttons' Rare Dwarf Vine Maple Japanese Maple Zones 6-8 Morning Sun to Afternoon Shade 'Baby Buttons’ is a dwarf compact form of vine maple that was introduced by Buchholz Nursery. It was found as a witches' broom on an Acer circinatum. The vine maple is indigenous to the Pacific Northwest. ‘Baby Buttons’ has the same rounded leaf as the species. It also has the same brilliant shades of yellow and orange in the fall. ‘Baby Buttons’ may reach 3 ft in height and width in a compact rounded form.

descriptions_zh.preferred: Acer circinatum 'Baby Buttons' 稀有矮生蔓枫，适生区 6-8，宜晨光至午后遮阴。 ‘Baby Buttons’ 是 Buchholz Nursery 推出的矮生紧凑型蔓枫，最初是在一株 Acer circinatum 上发现的扫帚状突变。 蔓枫原产于美国太平洋西北地区。 ‘Baby Buttons’ 保留了原种同样的圆形叶片，秋季也同样呈现灿烂的黄色和橙色。 ‘Baby Buttons’ 可形成紧凑圆整的株形，高宽约 3 英尺。 10 加仑规格植株因包装箱尺寸限制，发货时不含盆器。 请注意，您购买的 10 加仑植株到货时将不带容器。 除非您要求暂缓发货，否则会立即寄出。 请提前为不带容器的 10 加仑植株做好准备。
